construct_train_loader: construct a PyTorch training data loader with shuffling and drop_last enabled for cifar10 or imagenet
construct_test_loader: construct a PyTorch test data loader without shuffling for cifar10 or imagenet evaluation
shuffle_loader_epoch: shuffle a data loader by setting the epoch on its DistributedSampler for multi-process training
construct_loader_standard: construct a standard PyTorch DataLoader for a given dataset name, split, and batch size
construct_loader_ffcv: construct an FFCV-based data loader for fast image loading on imagenet with configurable pipelines
